body:
If you live in California, state privacy law gives you certain rights over the personal information that businesses collect about you. At One Stop Vape Store we collect only what we need to run the store, we do not sell your personal information, and we respond to requests to exercise your rights. This guide explains the rights in plain language, what personal information we collect, what we do not do, why we may need to keep some records, how to make a request, how we verify who you are, how long we take and where the details are in our policies. It is general information, not legal advice. Laws change and differ by state and city, so check the rules where you live. Everything we sell is for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## The law in brief
The California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act, gives California residents rights over their personal information and places duties on businesses that meet certain thresholds. The rights apply to personal information that identifies, relates to or could reasonably be linked with you or your household. The law aims to give you more visibility and control over how your information is used. Our [California privacy notice](/california-privacy/) sets out how it applies to us.

## Your rights
- **Know:** ask what personal information a business collects, uses and shares, and for what purposes.
- **Access:** ask for the specific pieces of personal information a business holds about you.
- **Delete:** ask a business to delete personal information, subject to exceptions.
- **Correct:** ask for inaccurate information to be fixed.
- **Opt out:** of the sale or sharing of personal information, where a business does either.
- **Limit:** the use of sensitive personal information in certain cases.
- **Non-discrimination:** you cannot be penalized for using these rights.

## What we collect
For orders: name, email, phone, shipping address, items ordered, order notes, payment method and payment confirmation details, including any proof you upload. For enquiries: the details in your message. For site operation: technical data such as IP address and pages requested, used for security and to limit abuse, plus items stored in your browser such as your age confirmation, your cart and your wishlist. Our [privacy policy](/privacy/) and [California privacy notice](/california-privacy/) provide the full list. We do not collect precise geolocation, biometric data or the other kinds of sensitive information the law lists.

## What we do not do
We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We use it to fulfill orders, provide support, process payments and meet legal obligations. We share it with service providers who help us run the store, such as hosting, order storage, email and delivery carriers, only as needed and under their own obligations. We do not knowingly sell or share the personal information of anyone under 16, and our products are for adults aged 21 and over.

## Why we keep some records
We may need to retain order information for tax, legal and compliance reasons even after a deletion request. For example, financial records may need to be kept for a number of years, and records connected with age-restricted sales may be needed to show that we complied with the law. When we keep something for these reasons, we tell you, and we limit how it is used. We delete or anonymize records when the reasons for keeping them end.

## How to make a request
Contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) or by email with your name, the email address used on your order and the request you are making. For access or deletion requests, mention the order or orders concerned if you can. You can also call during business hours. If you are using an authorized agent, tell us, and we will ask for your written permission. We will confirm that we have received your request.

## How we verify your identity
To protect your data, we may ask you to verify your identity before we act. In most cases we do this by matching details on the order, such as the email, name and order ID. We will not ask for more than we need. We will not ask for your passwords, PINs, private keys or recovery phrases. If we cannot verify your identity, we will explain why we cannot act on the request, and what you can do.

## How long it takes
We respond within 45 days of receiving a verifiable request. If we need more time, we can extend once by a further 45 days, and we will tell you why. Simple requests are often handled sooner. If we cannot do something, we will explain the reason.

## What you get back
For a request to know or access, we give you the categories and specific pieces of information we hold, in a readable format. For a deletion request, we delete the information we are not required to keep and tell you what we kept and why. For a correction request, we update the record and confirm. For opt-out requests, we confirm that we do not sell or share your information, and note your preference.

## Related reading
Read [why we ask for your email and phone](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/) and [how to use the private order page](/blog/how-to-use-the-order-payment-page/). If you are curious about how long we keep things, see the privacy policy.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Do I have to be a customer to make a request?
No. If you have contacted us or visited the site, you can ask what we hold. If we hold nothing identifiable, we will tell you.

### Will deleting my information cancel my order?
If an order is open, deleting the information needed to fulfil it would stop us delivering it. We will explain the effect before we act, and we may need to keep some records.

### Do you sell data to advertisers?
No. We do not sell personal information, and we do not run advertising tracking on the site.

### Can I make a request for someone else?
An authorized agent can make a request for you with your written permission, and we may confirm with you directly.

### What if I am not in California?
Other states have their own privacy laws, and our privacy policy applies to everyone. Contact us with your question and we will explain what we can do.

## Browse
Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A worked example: a deletion request
A customer in California writes to us from the email on their order, asking us to delete their personal information. We reply to confirm receipt and ask them to confirm the order ID to verify their identity. They do. We review the records: the order is complete and past the return window, so we delete the shipping address, the phone number and the uploaded payment images, keeping only the minimum order and payment record that we need for tax and accounting. We tell the customer what we deleted and what we kept and why, and we confirm that the information we kept is used only for those purposes. The whole process takes a few days, well within the 45-day limit.

## A worked example: an access request
Another customer asks what we hold about them. After verification, we send a summary of the categories, such as identifiers, order details and payment confirmation, and the specific items, such as the name, email, address and order history, along with the purposes and the service providers that process them. We also confirm that we do not sell or share the information. If the customer then wants a correction, we update the record.

## Good habits for your own privacy
Use an email address that you control, keep your devices updated, avoid sharing your private order link and be cautious of messages that ask for personal information. If you want to see or change what a business holds about you, do not hesitate to ask: the law exists to give you that right.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Does the law apply to all businesses?
It applies to businesses that meet certain thresholds. We apply the same standards of care to every customer, whether or not the law strictly applies, and we respond to requests from California residents as described in our notice.

### Can I opt out of marketing?
We do not use your order information for marketing without your consent. If we ever offer news or offers, you can opt out at any time through the contact page.

### What if I think my information was misused?
Contact us with the details. We will look into it and respond. You can also contact the relevant state authority.

## Where to read the full details
Our [privacy policy](/privacy/) explains what we collect, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and what choices you have. Our [California privacy notice](/california-privacy/) adds the categories of personal information and the rights specific to California residents. If something in this guide is unclear, those pages are the reference, and you can always contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) for help. We would rather answer a question than have you guess.

## A final reminder
Privacy rights are most useful when you use them. If you have ever wondered what a business knows about you, ask. If you spot a mistake in your details, ask for a correction. If you no longer want us to hold your information, ask for deletion. We will explain what we can do, and we will do it within the time the law allows.
